_comment: Logical model names used by the pipeline, and where their weights come from.
The MLflow registry is authoritative; 'fallback' is the local file used when
the registry is unreachable or the name was never registered, and every result
records which of the two it actually got.

ball_detector.note: recall 0.72 at imgsz 1280 on the video-3 GT window (232 labelled frames)

ball_detector_tiled.note: second opinion for --ball-ensemble; union recall 0.93 with the primary

pose_estimator.note: stock ultralytics weights; registered so a run records which ones

player_reid.note: Pinned frozen OSNet-x1.0/MSMT17. Install matching code/license bundle with scripts/models/install_player_reid.py; raw tracker IDs remain unchanged. Confirmed roster additions supported; no contact attribution.

net_sam.note: net tape/post segmentation. The fallback keeps today's behaviour (vit_h from ~/Downloads); models/sam_vit_b_01ec64.pth is a different checkpoint that was never the one being used. Register whichever should win and the ambiguity is gone — but re-run scripts/run_sam_net_detection.py if you switch, because calibration caches the result

event_sequence.note: four-class causal fit; register the new run once training finishes
